title: Simple Snow Elves
author: Grendel116
reason: Has not seen other elf overhauls yet, and has not seen the vanilla snow elves either, so does not know whether he wants anything changed about them.
revisitWhen: The elf / race-visual slot gets surveyed, and after seeing vanilla snow elves in play.
note: Not purely cosmetic: moves Snow Elves off Bethesda's incomplete SnowElfRace onto HighElfRace with a custom ability, so it edits race records. Bundles the author's Snow Elf Waifu variant.

title: Immersive Equipment Displays
author: SlavicPotato
reason: Author excluded. "Let's exclude this author, make a framework that includes our own simple dual sheath, and make our own display tweaks as well... We need to be ready to make our own version of everything he has. If possible, try to do a better job."
note: Skipped as a decision to BUILD the function, not to go without it. Replacement is the Ensrick Equipment Display Framework, clean-room on CommonLibSSE-NG 6.7.1, with Simple Dual Sheath folded in as a built-in slot set. Upstream is MIT, so a fork was permitted and was deliberately not taken; the clone is parked at skyrim-tools-source/_reference-ied-dev-DO-NOT-FORK for behaviour and config-schema reference only. Not installed: the equipment-display slot is currently filled by Simple Dual Sheath alone.

title: Simple Dual Sheath
author: SlavicPotato
reason: Author excluded; the feature is being built into our own framework instead of installed.
note: INSTALLED AND ENABLED at the time of the skip (SimpleDualSheath.dll 1.5.9). Stays until the Ensrick framework shows left-hand weapons and passes a launch verification, per exclusion rule 1. Shows the left-hand weapon and both staves while sheathed; needs a skeleton carrying the left-hand weapon nodes (XPMSSE 1988 is installed and enabled) and overlaps IED, so running both upstream mods means disabling features in one. Ours owns one node tree, so there is nothing to reconcile.

title: SSE Display Tweaks
author: SlavicPotato
reason: Author excluded; "we'll do our own version of SSE Display tweaks" next.
note: INSTALLED, ENABLED AND LOAD-BEARING at the time of the skip (SSE Display Tweaks Official 0.5.25). Owns borderless, the 119 fps limit, Havok fixed-step decoupling and WindowFocusGuard for the whole build (issue #149), and our own 'Ensrick - SSE Display Tweaks Configuration' overlay depends on its DLL. Does not come out until the replacement reaches parity and passes a launch verification. Prior art: Ensrick/SSEDisplayTweaks branch ensrick/1.7.99-format5 @2981fe3 located and byte-verified 26/26 patch sites in August, so the hard part is already mapped.
